label: Khao Yai
short_description: Mountain resorts and vineyard country around Khao Yai National Park, roughly 2-3 hours from Bangkok.
intro: Khao Yai's hotels in this directory cluster around Pak Chong district in Nakhon Ratchasima province, the main gateway to Khao Yai National Park -- Thailand's oldest national park and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The area is also one of Thailand's two wine-producing regions, with vineyards like PB Valley and GranMonte drawing day-trippers, and its cooler upland climate has made it a weekend-escape destination nicknamed the "Europe of Thailand," known for European-style architecture, golf courses, and countryside resorts rather than beach or city hotels.
